Nexys A7-100T (XC7A100T) | RMII Ethernet -> MoldUDP64 / ITCH 5.0 -> hardware LOB | 3 clock domains | sizes are v6 candidates, not synthesis results
clk_eth 50 MHz - RMII receive, parse, canonical events
A F E C X D U
rx byte[7:0], valid, last -> frame_ok, len -> ip payload -> mold msgs -> itch msg -> event[127:0]
error counters: bad FCS, malformed, unsupported, dropped, seq gap, buffer overflow
clk_core 100 MHz - CPU, system bus, LOB, recovery
async assert, sync release reset per domain
system bus: req_valid, req_write, req_addr[31:0], req_wdata[31:0], req_wstrb[3:0] | rsp_valid, rsp_rdata[31:0], rsp_error
Hardware LOB core (correctness-first sequencer, one RAM op in flight)
sequencer address / data / strobe to each RAM (scheduled, no shared-port conflicts)
Operation schedules (to be proven per RAM latency)
Add: pop free -> hash insert -> slot write -> price += -> occupancy set
Execute / Cancel: hash lookup -> slot read -> price -= -> slot update; occupancy clear at 0
Delete: lookup -> price -= -> slot free, hash remove, free push
Side and price always come from the stored slot, never from E / C / X fields
quantity under/overflow, duplicate or missing order ID, stash full,
FIFO overflow, malformed message -> error counter + BOOK_VALID = 0
assertions on the 10 LOB invariants, reference-model compare in sim
A = BBO snapshot req/ack, BOOK_VALID, LOB counters, init / clear
in RTL today (CPU, bus, IMEM, DMEM)
to be built (not yet in rtl/)
dashed arrow = status / control or CDC path; solid = data path
Sizes are v6 candidates; BRAM mapping not yet synthesized
